title: Paloma Rewards Redemption Limits Schedule
content:
Paloma Rewards points are redeemed within limits set per tier: a smallest and a largest redemption, a block size whose whole multiples must be used, a ceiling on redemptions in a rolling 30 calendar days, a balance that must remain after cash back, and whether an active Personal Sender Account is required.

| Tier | Fewest points per redemption | Redemption block (points) | Most points per redemption | Most redemptions in a rolling 30 calendar days | Points that must remain after a cash-back redemption | Active Personal Sender Account required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Blue | 500 | 500 | 2500 | 1 | 0 | Yes |
| Paloma Rewards Silver | 500 | 500 | 5000 | 2 | 0 | Yes |
| Paloma Rewards Gold | 500 | 500 | 10000 | 2 | 0 | Yes |
| Paloma Rewards Platinum | 400 | 100 | 20000 | 4 | 0 | Yes |
| Paloma Rewards Diamond | 300 | 100 | 40000 | 4 | 0 | Yes |
| Paloma Rewards Elite | 300 | 100 | 80000 | 8 | 0 | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- A redemption's points must be a whole multiple of the block, no fewer than the minimum and no more than the maximum. On Paloma Rewards Platinum (block 100, minimum 400, maximum 20000), 400, 500 and 20000 points are acceptable amounts, while 300 points (below the minimum) and 450 points (not a whole multiple of 100) are not.
- On Paloma Rewards Blue, Silver and Gold the block and the minimum are both 500, so the smallest redemption is a single block; on Paloma Rewards Diamond and Elite the smallest redemption is three blocks of 100.
- The points that must remain after a cash-back redemption are 0 on every tier, so a cash-back redemption may use the whole redeemable balance within the other limits.
- Every tier requires the member's Personal Sender Account to be active for a redemption.
